# MultiSig Tools Directory

> Catalog of multisig tools. MST's Stellar Testnet API is a separate service for human and AI Agent collaborators.

The directory is for navigation; it is not an API endpoint. The Stellar Testnet workspace provides self-service discovery and human-approved transaction workflows. Never infer Mainnet authority from Testnet credentials.

## Agent entry points

- [Agent quickstart](https://docs.multisig.tools/stellar/developers/agent-quickstart): Discover capabilities, request authorization, and verify safe first calls.
- [Testnet API Catalog](https://stellar-testnet.multisig.tools/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 catalog.
- [Testnet operation registry](https://api-testnet.multisig.tools/stellar/operations): Authoritative operation IDs, methods, access, and effects.
- [Testnet OpenAPI](https://api-testnet.multisig.tools/stellar/openapi.json): Schema and authentication.
- [Agent API](https://docs.multisig.tools/stellar/developers/agent-api): Signer-scoped credential permissions.
- [Testnet workspace](https://stellar-testnet.multisig.tools): Human approval surface.

- [API and webhooks](https://docs.multisig.tools/stellar/developers/api): Transport contract, errors, retries and webhook delivery.
- [Classic integration](https://docs.multisig.tools/stellar/developers/classic): Payment creation, signature and submission ownership.
- [Soroban integration](https://docs.multisig.tools/stellar/developers/soroban): Profile, detached AUTH, execution and exact-hash recovery.
- [Security](https://docs.multisig.tools/stellar/developers/security): Credential and authorization boundaries.
- [State and error reference](https://docs.multisig.tools/stellar/developers/reference): Lifecycle states, retry vocabulary and error catalogue.
